citation: Smitka K, et al. Nutr Metab 2011;8:81
protocol: Cycle ergometer 45 min at 2 W/kg lean body mass (60 rpm); blood at 0 min (basal), 45 min (exercise) and 90 min post-exercise; the Acipimox columns are a separate arm (read the placebo/exercise-alone columns)
population: 8 healthy women (25.8 +/- 1.7 y, BMI 20.0 +/- 0.4) as controls, alongside 8 women with bulimia nervosa (24.3 +/- 1.4 y)
note: Controls printed separately from the bulimia group; low-to-moderate bout; FFA rise at 45 min is clear; Acipimox arm should be ignored.
